title: Plan a reliable release
description: Use the internal AI workspace to draft a short release-readiness plan for a small open-source project. Explain your goal, a verification step, and a risk with a mitigation. The mock assistant offers predefined guidance; you remain responsible for the final submission. This sample demonstrates the framework and does not measure real-world collaboration skill.

initial_resources.name: project-brief.txt
initial_resources.content: A small team is preparing its first open-source release. The demo needs a reproducible setup, a working test suite, and documented limitations. Draft a concise release-readiness plan in English.

submission.instructions: Submit a short plan in English with Goal, Verification, and Risk sections. State the release goal, how you will verify it, and a risk with a mitigation. This demonstration rubric awards points for the named sections only.

criteria.title: Release goal
criteria.description: Include a Goal section that states what the release should achieve.

criteria.title: Verification plan
criteria.description: Include a Verification section that describes how to check the result.

criteria.title: Risk and mitigation
criteria.description: Include a Risk section identifying a possible failure and a mitigation.
